title: Grade 6
blurb: Unit-by-unit practice for the whole Grade 6 year — ratios and rates, fractions, decimals, percents, integers, factors, expressions and equations, the coordinate plane, area and volume, and statistics.

units.title: Ratios & Rates
units.blurb: Writing and simplifying ratios, equivalent ratios, comparing them, rates and unit rates.

units.title: Fractions
units.blurb: Equivalence and comparison, the four operations on fractions, and fraction word problems.

units.title: Decimals
units.blurb: Decimal place value, comparing and rounding, and the four operations on decimals.

units.title: Percentages
units.blurb: Percent of a number, what percent one number is of another, increase and decrease, and finding the whole.

units.title: Integers
units.blurb: Comparing and ordering, absolute value and opposites, and the four operations on signed numbers.

units.title: Factors and Multiples
units.blurb: Factors and multiples, primes and composites, greatest common factor, least common multiple and prime factorisation.

units.title: Expressions and Equations
units.blurb: Exponents, order of operations, writing and evaluating expressions, equivalence and one-step equations.

units.title: Coordinate Plane
units.blurb: Quadrants, plotting and reading points, reflections across the axes, and distance between points.

units.title: Geometry: Area and Volume
units.blurb: Area of rectangles, parallelograms, triangles and trapezoids, composite figures, volume and surface area.

units.title: Data and Statistics
units.blurb: Mean, median, mode and range, reading dot plots and histograms, and describing a data set.
